featured.title: Modernizing Data Infrastructure at Peloton Using Apache Hudi
featured.description: Peloton re-architected its data platform using Apache Hudi to transition to 10-minute ingestion cycles using CDC. This migration reduced operational costs, improved data freshness, and simplified GDPR compliance.

featured.title: Fusing Elasticsearch with Neural Networks to Identify Data
featured.description: Integrated Elasticsearch with deep learning models to improve data identification and search relevance. Developed a hybrid system combining keyword search with neural network embeddings for semantic understanding at scale.

talks.title: How Our Team Used Open Table Formats to Boost Querying and Reduce Latency
talks.description: Discussed how Peloton utilized Apache Hudi to enhance data querying on Amazon S3. Built near real-time data pipelines using Hudi, Spark, and Kafka to reduce ETL costs and improve data freshness for ML workflows.

talks.title: Building a data platform with open source: A $1M+ cost-saving journey
talks.description: Explored how open-source tools can create a self-service data platform. Shared a case study of transitioning from SaaS solutions to custom platforms, saving over $1M annually.
